first_round_reuse: B1/B2 are derived controls; B3/Agent fork identical original ballots without rebinding votes
majority_rule: at least two of three explicit same verdicts; axis labels also use absolute majority
initial_packet_policy: exact GPT-reference initial candidate and evidence; GPT labels never sent
branches: B3 and Agent start concurrently from the same post-initial checkpoint and deadline
weight_policy: frozen dynamic check_completion_v1 with common cold-start prior; no online reliability update
prior_extraction_unknown: retained separately; no extraction request is repeated
reference_binding_role: identifies original GPT packet; current audit/proposal IDs are recorded separately
